description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). A read: the pages of ours a draft or post should link (posts, services, solutions and case studies sharing its distinctive words), each with why and where (the section, the paragraph and a phrase for the anchor), never one it already links; and the open searches that match your own work: searches people make that competitors rank for, or that we target, and that no post of ours answers yet. Send markdown, id (one of your drafts) or post (one of your published posts); nothing at all for topics only. Deterministic, no model; it changes nothing.

id.description: One of your drafts (the id submit_draft returned): its saved text

markdown.description: The post's text, frontmatter included. With id: an edit of that draft, read instead of its saved text

post.description: One of your published posts: its URL (https://www.techfabric.com/blog/<slug>) or its slug

name: suggest_links_and_topics

terms.description: The text's own distinctive words, the links are matched on

title: Suggest links and topics
